contract.semantic_meaning: One current record for each order. Net revenue is captured USD payments less refunded USD returns allocated to that order. The fixture contains 10 completed paid orders; no conversion, tax or chargeback logic is implied. This differs from Modeling's gross completed-order Revenue metric.

rules.description: 1 row / current order. Repeating this key can repeat measures; uniqueness supports this declaration but does not prove row meaning.
